# Draft:Joe Woodward

#REDIRECTJoseph Woodward (rugby union)
Joe Woodward (born 17 September 2003) is an English professional rugby union footballer who plays at centre for Premiership Rugby club Leicester Tigers.
Club career
He made his debut for Leicester Tigers in 2022 in the Premiership Rugby Cup.
He spent time on loan at the RFU Championship club Nottingham Rugby during the 2023-24 season.
International career
He represented England Under-20s in the 2022-23 season.
